ext_desc.message: Honest 0–100 score on any home for sale, on any property website: price vs similar homes, location and red flags. Free.

disclaimer.message: Estimate, not an appraisal. Check every detail with the seller.

consent_short.message: Allow RealHunt to use anonymous listing data (price, m², area) to compare prices with other listings?

consent_body.message: RealHunt Score only works on supported property sites. With your OK we store derived listing data (price, size, area, score, a hashed listing ID) to compare prices, plus your answers if you create a profile. We never store photos or full descriptions, never track other browsing and never sell data. You can delete everything at any time.
